questions.question_text: Roles and ResponsibilitiesWhat is the main benefit of assigning specific roles to team members based on their strengths when planning an event?

options.text: It ensures everyone gets paid equally for their work
It allows each person to focus on tasks they’re good at or enjoy, making the planning process more efficient
It guarantees the event will have no problems or delays
It means the team leader doesn’t have to do any work

correct_answer.text: It allows each person to focus on tasks they’re good at or enjoy, making the planning process more efficient

questions.question_text: Effective Communication StrategiesWhich of the following is the most effective way to keep a team updated and on the same page during event planning?

options.text: Only talking to team members when there’s a problem
Holding regular short meetings and using tools like group chats or shared documents for updates
Letting each person figure out their tasks without checking in
Sending long emails every day with every small detail

correct_answer.text: Holding regular short meetings and using tools like group chats or shared documents for updates

questions.question_text: Conflict Resolution in TeamsWhat is a key step in resolving a disagreement between team members planning an event?

options.text: Ignoring the issue and hoping it goes away on its own
Listening to both sides calmly and finding common ground or a compromise
Telling the team leader to pick a side immediately
Removing the arguing members from the team

correct_answer.text: Listening to both sides calmly and finding common ground or a compromise

questions.question_text: Motivating Your CrewHow can a team leader best keep morale high during the stressful parts of event planning?

options.text: By focusing only on the tasks and ignoring how the team feels
By showing appreciation, celebrating small wins, and adding fun elements to the process
By giving everyone extra work to keep them busy
By promising big rewards that might not be possible to deliver

correct_answer.text: By showing appreciation, celebrating small wins, and adding fun elements to the process
